content.short: Agora provides end-to-end on-chain governance software used by major protocols.
content.description: Agora builds governance systems that protocols deploy without writing code, covering proposals, voting and progressive decentralisation, and is used by major communities such as Optimism and Uniswap. It powers World Vote, a pilot of verified voting with World ID that runs as a mini app in World App.
content.meta: Agora provides on-chain governance software for major protocols and powers World Vote in World App.
